notes.title: Add New Episode
notes.content:
[h2]Major update[/h2]
[b]Episode 4 will be added on 14th of Aug[/b]

You have to go through a tunnel under construction to get to the lab. 
Sure. The lab is the crux of the matter.

Then Is this tunnel just under construction? Will it give you a pleasant experience?
Hmm....
Whatever you expect, it will be awesome.

Of course that's not all you have to do here. You need to find Brad as well. 
Who is Brad? What for? You will get to know.

The atmosphere in the tunnel will be completely different from what you've experienced so far. 
Always be careful. Someone's after you!

Please wait for the next two days!

notes.title: Bug fix and some updates
notes.content:
[b]We just fixed some bugs and reflected players opinion.[/b]

Please refer to the list below

1. Modified blackening
2. Modified how sensor phrases show behind you back
3. Add Smooth Rotation Options
4. Add Cosmos controller input settings.
5. Fixed hand location problems in SteamVR
6. Automatic HMD height adjustment function
7. Fixed zombie jump bugs
8. Modified medicine explanation Image
9. Made them easy to play close-range weapons, drawers and books
10. Clear the way to move in EP2
11. Modified not to die from grenades during EP0 tutorial.

Many thanks

Please feel free to give us an idea about what you want to have in Deadgroundz.

notes.title: Launching Dead GroundZ
notes.content:
[h1][b]Finally launching Dead GroundZ on 29th of April[/b][/h1]
[previewyoutube=2II6VWnP4wQ;full][/previewyoutube]

First, We are [b]really sorry[/b] for the players who have been waiting for this for a long time.

We finally launches VR Shooter Dead GroundZ on 29th of April. After our ambitious first move into the gaming market by launching the Dead Ground Arena and Dead Ground Arcade, we are now ready to give you much better VR gaming experiences with the release of first-person shooter, Dead GroundZ.

Players will [b]dive deep into three episodes of story-driven VR gameplay[/b] set around top-secret agencies and gruesome, forbidden experiments. you [b]take on the role of an agent for “White Parasol”[/b] to investigate strange goings-on reported to be taking place on a remote island, intel suggests that the [b]secret agency[/b] Blackrain is responsible. The once deserted island is not very desolate anymore, and instead it has become a vacation destination for failed experiments and other terrifying creatures. 

While collecting a wide variety of weapons to survive the attacks from up to 30 different crawling, running or jumping beasts, you will [b]investigate[/b] the secrets of “Blackrain”, protect witnesses, and unravel the truth behind these monstrosities.

notes.title: Beta test and release date
notes.content:
[h1][b]Beta test [/b][/h1]

We are now very happy to finally share our schedule with you.

We will conduct a beta test [b]for a month in January[/b]. We will receive feedback on our game from VR game video creators. This will also include video production for YouTube etc.

[h1][b]Release date[/b][/h1]

After successfully completing the beta test and reflecting the feedback of the testers into our game, we will launch Dead GroundZ [b]in February 2019[/b].

Please [i]join[/i] our beta test for the VR professional YouTube creators who are interested in our game. Thank you.

[u][b]Let's take a look at the beta test of Dead GroundZ below[/b][/u]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NO4PZoi0XC0&t=3s]Dead GroundZ Episode 1[/url]
